note: Where to write, for the archives we have actually written to. Every address was met in a family archive's own research (a letter sent, a reply, an institution's own contact page) or read off the institution's own official page (via web:); none is guessed and none is taken from a person. Role mailboxes only: no address that names a member of staff is kept, and nothing about a person goes in. Joined to providers.json by id, so «Where the paper is» can show an e-mail icon. Wikidata's addresses (provider-contacts.json) fill in where this file has none. «offices» holds an institution's postal address, switchboard, contact form and branch lines, read off its own page; no staff name or direct line is kept.

states.answered: a reply came from the institution, to a letter sent here
states.delivered: a letter was sent and delivered; no reply is recorded
states.listed: published by the institution (or an official page) and not yet written to
states.unverified: found only in a snippet or a third-party listing; confirm on the institution's own page before writing
states.dead: bounced, retired or not in use: recorded so nobody tries it again, never shown as a contact
